lines.text: Many learners say: The price is very expensive.
Better: The price is very high.
A price is high or low.
High! The price is too high.

data.why: A price is high or low.

native.tip: 中文说“价格很贵”。英语里 expensive 用来说东西，说价格要用 high 或 low。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “The price is very expensive.”😅 中文说“价格很贵”，英语说价格要用 high：“The price is very high.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.hook: A price is high, not expensive!
en.tip: Chinese says a price is expensive. In English, expensive is for things, and a price is high or low.
en.caption: Do you say “The price is very expensive.” 😅 For a price, use high or low: “The price is very high.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
